finding: Comments posted under big media accounts earn almost no attention: in the 16 Nov campaign, 10 replies on X under news accounts drew 1 like, 7 replies on writers' Substack Notes drew 2, and none drew a reply. Borrowed audiences come from partners and Substack's network, not from replies under news accounts, so comment effort goes, at most, to a few Notes conversations with business-AI writers, judged by subscribers.

evidence.result: 18 of 23 comments read at about 47 hours: X 10 comments, 1 like; Substack Note replies 7, 2 likes; Instagram 1 of 5 readable, 0 likes; 0 replies anywhere.

revisit_when: After the next weekly subscriber read: if any new subscriber is traced to a comment or Notes reply, reopen.
